ledger.note: 8 October 1656: the elector dies. Infobox period begins 'Death of elector Johann Georg I: 8 October 1656'; 'upon his death the Duchies of Saxe-Zeitz, Saxe-Merseburg and Saxe-Weissenfels arose', the latter 'granted to the second eldest son Augustus'; lead: 'a Duchy of the Holy Roman Empire from 1656 until 1746'. His will (20 July 1652) had given his younger sons secundogeniture duchies. Review follow-up: the four Magdeburg lordships (Querfurt, Jüterbog, Dahme, Burg) are part of the founding land. The first version entered them as a separate 1656 gain from archbishopric-of-magdeburg, but the page says they had been 'adjudicated to Saxony by the 1635 Peace of Prague' and electorate-of-saxony's ledger has the 1635 gain from Magdeburg; the 1656 event was also dated before the found event. The six Ämter are added to the founding land (page: 'Beside Weissenfels the duchy comprised the ämters of Freyburg, Sachsenburg (present-day Oldisleben), Sangerhausen, Eckartsberga, Weißensee and Langensalza').

notes:
Written 2026-10-25 for batch eu-09-x (1 page; budget 1-2). New state: Cliopatria has no Saxe-Weissenfels row.

SCOPE. A secundogeniture of the Albertine Wettins: Imperial State and 'member of the Upper Saxon Circle, though without a vote in the Reichstag'. The page is silent on wars; the 1635 Peace of Prague is the only treaty named. The infobox's predecessor and successor fields are garbled on the page, so the Electorate of Saxony is entered from the text.

SHAPES. Circles: Weissenfels 11.97E 51.20N 20 km; Querfurt 11.60E 51.38N 12 km; Jüterbog 13.07E 51.99N 10 km; Dahme 13.43E 51.87N 8 km; Burg 11.85E 52.27N 8 km; Barby 11.88E 51.99N 10 km. Gazetteer names wanted: 'Weissenfels', 'Querfurt', 'Jüterbog', 'Dahme (Mark)', 'Burg bei Magdeburg', 'Barby'.

NOT SETTLED. (1) The years of Querfurt, Jüterbog, Dahme and Burg (entered at the start, confidence 1); (2) no area; (3) the Brandenburg slug for 1687 is the electorate's dossier.

COUNTERPARTS NEEDING DOSSIERS: none new (County of Barby is free text).

REVISION 2026-10-25 (after review). (1) Six Ämters named by the page (Freyburg, Sachsenburg/Oldisleben, Sangerhausen, Eckartsberga, Weissensee, Langensalza) were undrawn; circles added to K0-K2, the found event, the dissolve and the predecessor and successor lands (about 5,800 km2 on the grid, was 2,800). The page gives no area, so the area check is not computable. (2) The 1656 gain of the four Magdeburg lordships from archbishopric-of-magdeburg is deleted and folded into the found event (counterpart electorate-of-saxony): the page says the lordships were 'adjudicated to Saxony by the 1635 Peace of Prague', and electorate-of-saxony's ledger holds the 1635 gain. (3) The sale of Burg (1687) names brandenburg-prussia (set by the earlier fix); that dossier has no 1687 gain to mirror it. Gazetteer names wanted: 'Freyburg (Unstrut)', 'Oldisleben', 'Sangerhausen', 'Eckartsberga', 'Weissensee (Thuringia)', 'Langensalza'.
